Theme

Household, washing & chores · Computing & programming

battery noun

also rechargeable battery, cell, accumulator

modern

Traupman 277

accumulātrum, accumulātrī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a rechargeable battery, as in a phone, a laptop or a car

What Italian and German call accumulatore and Akku: the battery that is filled again and again.

Other words

  • pīla ēlectrica — a cell, the battery one takes out and replaces

    modern · M-O s.v. battery (the Vatican lexicon, Helfer, Egger)

    Volta’s own name for his “pile” of plates. Pīla, a pillar, differs from pila, a ball, only in its long vowel.

  • pyxis ēlectrica

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. battery

Examples

  • Pīlae exhaustae sunt; novās īnsere.

    The batteries are dead; put new ones in.composed

See also charge, charger.
